jobs.title: Controls Room – Product Owner - Associate
jobs.description:
As a  Controls Room Product Owner (Associate) , you will support the product strategy and delivery for our products, enabling effective oversight and execution across the control environment. You will drive measurable improvements in how test plans are designed, monitored, and executed—leveraging AI-enabled and agentic workflow patterns to improve efficiency, consistency, and transparency while maintaining appropriate controls and human oversight.
You will operate with a “speed-to-production” mindset, executing through an iterative delivery approach (e.g., Pizza POD model) to rapidly prototype, validate with users, and scale durable capabilities. Partnering closely with Software Engineering, Data Science, Design, Control Management, and Compliance stakeholders, you will help drive an outcome-focused roadmap, balance risk and value trade-offs, and ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, stable, and adoptable.
Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment across the firm. With Control Managers appointed for each Line of Business, Function and Region, there is a comprehensive coverage and joint accountability model with the business executive that promotes early operational risk identification and assessment, effective design and evaluation of controls and sustainable solutions to mitigate operational risk.
The Controls Room Team within Control Management works collaboratively with other control disciplines and oversees existing control functions as well as the development of new control functions and protocols. The team’s objective is to empower the three lines of defense with risk-based information to manage their control environment. We achieve this by collecting, analyzing and monitoring firmwide risk-based intelligence into all lines of business and corporate functions.
The Controls Room gathers information from key business and technology partners in order to:
•               Facilitate better decision making and actionable insights across the Firm.
•               Create cost-effective and automated reporting; and
•               Provide views into risk and issues.
Job Responsibilities:
- Support product strategy and delivery for the Controls Room Product ecosystem; align priorities to user needs and oversight objectives.
- Lead customer discovery activities (interviews, workflow analysis, pain-point identification) to translate needs into a prioritized roadmap/backlog and clear value proposition.
- Execute delivery in an agile Pizza POD model: rapid prototyping (using GitHub Co-Pilot / Claude/ChatGPT, etc.), short development cycles, and continuous feedback loops with users and stakeholders.
- Own and maintain the product backlog: write/refine epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and aligned to outcomes.
- Contribute to AI enablement within the product: identify high-impact use cases (e.g., NLP-driven insights, automation, decision support) and support responsible deployment with appropriate controls, monitoring, and human-in-the-loop review.
- Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Design to deliver solutions that are scalable, resilient, stable, and adaptable across testing organizations.
- Establish and track success metrics (e.g., productivity, cycle time, coverage, reliability, control outcomes) and use data to guide prioritization and iteration.
- Support go-to-market and change management: launch planning, training/readiness, documentation, and post-launch support to drive adoption and measurable business impact.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:
- 3+ years of relevant experience in product management/ownership, business analysis, project delivery, process improvement, or technology/tooling enablement (or equivalent expertise).
- Demonstrated experience contributing to product delivery across the lifecycle (discovery, delivery, adoption, optimization) with accountability for results.
- Proven ability to deliver iteratively in a fast-paced model using short development cycles and small teams (e.g., Pizza POD / agile squad).
- Strong backlog/requirements skills (epics, user stories, acceptance criteria) and comfort partnering closely with engineering and design.
- Strong stakeholder management skills; ability to align outcomes, negotiate trade-offs, and drive timely decisions.
- Understanding of risk and controls concepts (risk assessment, control evaluations, testing, or related).
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:
- Experience working in or closely with audit, compliance, risk management, and/or control testing organizations.
- Experience delivering AI-enabled workflow capabilities (in production or pilots) with emphasis on transparency, auditability, and human oversight.
- Experience using AI tools (GitHub CoPilot, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to generate prototypes and aid/execute SDLC
- Familiarity with modern data and analytics tools (e.g., Databricks, ThoughtSpot, Sigma, Prophecy, Python).

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are not able to provide immigration sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

jobs.title: Data Product Owner - Trust & Estates

jobs.title: Asset Management - Product Owner - Vice President

As a product owner on a mission-critical data product, you’ll own the product vision and execution for many efforts, including the data services that power client reporting, operational workflows, and investment processes—while pushing the frontier on AI-enabled automation, Agentic AI readiness, and modern data quality engineering. This role is for a builder who thrives in ambiguity, moves with agility and sharp judgment, and turns complex, high-stakes data problems into durable products that teams actually adopt. If you want a long runway, real impact, and a front-row seat to how AI reshapes enterprise data, this is your seat

Job responsibilities

- Own delivery end-to-end for a critical data domain—intake through outcomes—ensuring delivery aligns to business priorities and measurable client/user value.

- Run the product operating cadence: intake/demand management, prioritization, roadmap sequencing, and release execution.

- Translate complex needs into crisp product direction: define problem statements, use cases, success metrics, user journeys, and acceptance criteria that enable delivery teams to move quickly without losing rigor.

- Measure what matters: establish and maintain delivery and outcome metrics (quality, timeliness, adoption, STP lift, defect reduction, cycle time) and use them to refine the roadmap.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Proven track record as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Delivery Lead for data products, platforms, or critical enterprise services.

- At least 5 years of Financial Services experience, with data, technology and operations experience blended with knowledge of Asset& Wealth Management data concepts

- Delivered in agile environments with real backlog discipline, pragmatic scope control, and outcome-based execution

- Comfortable with SQL and/or Python, navigating large datasets to validate hypotheses, investigate issues, and partner credibly with engineering and analytics

Area Product Owners are business leads for a particular area, scrum team within the product who directly engage with various partners e.g. business sponsors, technology, operations, legal, risk, compliance etc. They are accountable for the overall health and value delivered for the product.  As Due Diligence Platform Area Product Owner, the role is responsible for the product’s objectives, roadmaps, and key performance indicators across the Due Diligence Teams. - Largely sets strategy, drives product level strategic & tactical decisions

- Analyzes feedback from end users and other product partners on platform improvement opportunities

- Supports defining product level Objectives and Key Results with participation of Product Owners; including prioritization of work and product sprint planning

- Sets day-to-day priorities for Product team as Subject Matter Expert (SME) and continuously works with Technology, Designers, and Business Users; engages with broader business groups, e.g. Risk, Controls, Strategic Partnerships, etc. to ensure business vision alignment and drive progress and outcomes

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

- 10 years of direct experience as a senior business person, program manager, or technology platform owner in a complex organization that has brought new portfolio management solutions to market

- Solid understanding of Portfolio Management and or Due Diligence Tools

- Direct asset and wealth management experience, preferably in multi-asset environment with broad experience covering equity, fixed income markets, commodity and currency; Working knowledge of fund of funds business and a variety of investment products including mutual funds, ETFs, hedge funds, structured products, etc.

- Proven ability to manage a large book of work with budgeting and financial skills, parse complex technology/delivery details to make them understandable to a wide audience, and drive concepts to execution; strong written and verbal communication skills to thrive on a global team

- Deep understanding of agile development practices to juggle priorities in a highly dynamic cross-functional collaboration during scoping, design, implementation, and rollout

- Understand product priorities and align backlog of work for developing value in increments

Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with the operators who protect our people, assets, and reputation.

As a Product Manager Vice President in Global Security, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing products that create tangible value for the security professionals who use them. In this role, you will be empowered to shape and influence the strategic vision and execution for an  experience product  that unifies the day-to-day workflows of our  SOCs, Executive Protection, Aviation, Intelligence, and Workforce Screening  teams. This is not a horizontal platform — it is the interface, workflow, and decision-support layer these teams rely on to detect threats, protect principals, secure flights, produce intelligence, and vet the workforce. Partnering with Engineering, Data & Analytics, User and Employee Experience (UX/EX), Security Operations, and Product Delivery Managers, you will translate deep operator insight into cohesive, role-based experiences — embedding auditable workflows, contextual data, and capability enhancements that drive operational efficiency and faster, better decisions. You will help position Global Security at the forefront of user-centered, data-driven innovation, ensuring every persona has the right information, at the right moment, in the right form to act.

Job Responsibilities

- Develop a product strategy and product vision for an integrated Global Security experience that delivers measurable value to SOCs, Executive Protection, Aviation, Intelligence, and Workforce Screening users.

- Manage discovery efforts and market research to uncover unmet operator needs and integrate them into the product roadmap.

- Own, maintain, and evolve a product backlog that enables engineering to support the overall strategic roadmap, user-experience vision, and value proposition.

- Build the framework and track the product's key success metrics — including user adoption, task time, workflow completion, decision quality, feature performance, risk posture, and reliability.

- Conduct deep analyses of end-to-end operator journeys, tools, and data touchpoints — supplemented by stakeholder interviews, shadowing sessions, and usability research — to validate problems, uncover friction, and define high-impact experience opportunities across all five customer teams.

- Facilitate cross-functional workshops and design sessions with UX/EX, Engineering, Security Operations, Intelligence analysts, and functional data owners to capture requirements, drive consensus, and align on user-journey and interaction designs.

- Refine and prioritize the product backlog: author epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira/Confluence; manage dependencies with Product Delivery Managers; and maintain release plans anchored to user outcomes.

- Embed data governance, security controls, and compliance requirements into every feature through cross-functional partnerships to deliver audit-ready, enterprise-grade experiences appropriate for sensitive security use cases.

- Lead Agile delivery — running sprint planning, coordinating QA/UAT with operator representatives from each team, managing release deployments, and driving swift defect and production-issue resolution to ensure on-time, high-quality releases.

- Partner with upstream data, integration, and analytics platform teams (including Automation, Reporting & Intelligent Analytics — ARIA) to surface predictive insights, automated workflows, and role-based dashboards inside the experience where operators actually work.

- Define, track, and report on key success metrics (adoption, task efficiency, incident response times, user satisfaction/NPS, reliability, risk posture), using interactive dashboards and retrospectives to drive continuous experience improvement.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

- 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area.

- Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, user-centered design, and data analytics.

- Proven ability to lead product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management.

- Hands-on Product Management experience delivering  user-facing/experience products  in enterprise security, operations, or incident-management domains, with a proven track record launching large-scale products that consolidate multiple workflows for professional operator personas.

- Deep expertise in Agile methodologies and tools (Jira/Confluence), including backlog prioritization, epic/user-story definition, release planning, and full product lifecycle management.

- Strong understanding of user experience principles, journey mapping, and workflow design — combined with working knowledge of the underlying data, APIs, and event-driven services (e.g., Kafka, REST/GraphQL) that power modern experience products.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate operator research and complex datasets into actionable experience enhancements.

- Exceptional communication, influencing, and executive-presence skills — adept at driving consensus in highly matrixed environments, distilling diverse stakeholder feedback, and delivering compelling executive presentations.

- Proven ability to lead end-to-end product discovery, ideation, and user research, and to translate business and operator requirements into strategic roadmap priorities.

- Demonstrated success managing competing priorities and building cross-functional partnerships across engineering, UX/EX, operations, and delivery teams.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

- Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Design, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

- Direct experience building products for one or more of the following operator communities:  Security Operations Centers (SOCs), Executive Protection, Intelligence/all-source analysis, Aviation or Workforce Screening.

- Familiarity with SIEM/SOAR platforms, unified command-and-control systems, GSOC tooling, case-management systems, or intelligence production workflows.

- Experience partnering with AI/ML and analytics teams to embed predictive models, automated workflows, and advanced dashboards into user-facing experiences, accelerating operator decision-making.

- Experience leveraging process-mining, task-mining, and journey-analytics tools to optimize operator workflows.

- Familiarity with data-sharing frameworks, entitlement services, and data-governance best practices as they apply to sensitive security data surfaced in user experiences.

jobs.title: Asset & Wealth Management - Product Manager, Applied AI & Data Products - Vice President
jobs.description:
Own a high-impact portfolio of unified data products—spanning applied AI, advanced analytics, visualization, and regulatory solutions—powered by the Global Private Bank’s federated data mesh.

The Analytics & Applied AI team within the Chief Data & Analytics Office (CDAO) of the Global Private Bank is responsible for unified data products — data products that cut across multiple core data domains — delivered through a multi-pod model and underpinned by the federated data mesh and its distribution points. The team's capabilities span applied AI, advanced analytics, data visualization, and regulatory and compliance data products, all aligned to the broader data mesh strategy.

As the Product Manager within the Chief Data & Analytics Office you will own the product strategy and delivery for a portfolio of unified data products spanning applied AI, analytics and visualization, and regulatory and compliance domains. The role is a balanced blend of general product management craft — vision, roadmap, backlog, discovery, metrics, and stakeholder management — with hands-on ownership of specific key initiatives across the portfolio.

This is an AI-forward product management role. We’re seeking a leader who consistently applies AI and large language model (LLM) tools both in the products they build and in their day-to-day product management practice—using them to speed up discovery, clarify requirements, accelerate prototyping, and streamline delivery, while shipping intelligent, AI-enabled data products.

Job Responsibilities

- Define and own the product vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for the assigned portfolio of data products

- Own and prioritize the product backlog; write clear requirements and user stories; partner with engineering and scrum leads on delivery

- Conduct customer and user discovery, define success metrics (KPIs and OKRs), and measure outcomes

- Manage stakeholders across CDAO, the Global Private Bank, and partner teams; communicate trade-offs and progress

- Champion data quality, governance, privacy, and regulatory compliance throughout the product lifecycle

- Bring demonstrated, hands-on experience as a product manager who ships AI- and LLM-powered features and products, including the application of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and AI agents

- Use AI and LLM tooling within your own product management workflow to accelerate discovery, requirements definition, prototyping, and delivery

- Partner closely with applied AI and data science teams to operationalize models responsibly, with appropriate controls for quality, safety, privacy, and compliance

- Champion an AI-forward mindset across the portfolio, identifying where intelligent capabilities can meaningfully improve data products and the experiences built on top of them

-
Deliver unified data products across multiple core data domains, aligned with the data mesh strategy

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Financial services experience commensurate with a Vice President level role of 7+ years, in data and analytics, wealth /private banking, related domains

- Demonstrated product management experience delivering data and/or analytics/AI products end to end

- Strong, demonstrated experience building and shipping AI- and LLM-powered products, and fluency using AI and LLM tools within the product management workflow. This is a core requirement of the role

- Familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Starburst, Databricks) and data product and data mesh concepts

- Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead through influence across engineering pods

- Bachelor's degree required

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Experience with regulatory and compliance data products

- Experience with GenAI/LLM application patterns, prompt engineering, AI agents, and vector search / retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

- Familiarity with operating within a federated data mesh model

- Advanced degree a plus

jobs.description:
The Credit Portfolio Lending Group (CPG) is a public-side global function with approximately 25 Portfolio Management and Trading professionals across New York, London, and Singapore, and is part of the Markets function within the Commercial & Investment Bank (CIB). CPG has two primary functions: Portfolio Management & Research (PM&R), which is aligned by industry and geography, and Trading & Distribution (T&D), which uses both liquid and illiquid channels to risk manage the book. The priority of the group is to manage the retained credit portfolio, focusing on concentrated exposures (company-specific, industry, or geographical concentrations) while balancing the competing priorities of minimizing cost, P&L volatility, and capital usage. Portfolio Managers and Researchers work with Traders to determine appropriate strategies to manage the portfolio, achieved primarily via the secondary loan market, the CDS market, and through structured solutions.
The Quantitative Research (QR) function supporting CPG is responsible for developing and maintaining trading models and platforms, as well as building analytics, portfolio monitoring tools and algorithms that support CPG’s activities. Responsibilities span the full lifecycle from new model and process specification and approval through to implementation and integration into risk and P&L systems.

In this role, you will serve as the primary quant for CPG delivering cutting-edge AI tools and models that enhance the group's portfolio management, trading, and distribution capabilities. There will be a particular emphasis on leveraging AI, large language models (LLMs), and generative AI agents to design and implement market-based tools that provide the desk with a quantitative edge, accelerate automation, and improve decision-making across the credit portfolio.

Job Responsibilities
- Design, build, and deploy AI, LLM, and generative AI agent-based tools to support CPG trading workflows, including automated market analysis, credit curve maintenance, trade idea generation, and portfolio risk monitoring
- Explore and implement machine learning techniques to enhance trading signal generation and portfolio optimization strategies
- Stay at the forefront of emerging AI capabilities and identify practical applications that can be embedded into the desk's daily operations
- Leverage the vast amount of data available across the credit portfolio to proactively identify opportunities, concentrated exposures, and optimal hedging strategies for the desk
- Collaborate with model control teams to facilitate timely and efficient review and approval of all models, ensuring compliance with internal policies and industry regulations
- Automate trading desk daily risk and position reports, streamlining workflows to accelerate the broader automation & digital transformation agenda across CPG
- Build and enhance trade support and automation infrastructure for portfolio hedging strategies, credit curve reconciliation, and loan sale execution
- Interact with other sub-teams within Markets QR to explore synergies and share best practices

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
- An advanced degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, financial engineering, computer science, or an equivalent subject
- At least 4 years of experience in a quantitative research, markets, or analytics-focused role supporting a fixed income, credit, or lending desk

- Hands-on experience in portfolio optimization, familiar with related software and tools

- Establish prompt refinement and optimization practices: continuously develop, test, and tune system prompts/instructions and few-shot examples; improve quality, token efficiency, and response latency through disciplined iteration.

Leverage your deep technical expertise and leadership to guide cutting-edge projects, fostering growth and innovation in a dynamic environment.

As a Lead Technical Program Manager at JPMorganChase in AIML Data Platforms – Chief Data & Analytics team, you will drive the successful delivery of complex technology projects and programs that will help reaching business goals across the firm. Leveraging your deep knowledge of technical principles, practices, and theories is essential for developing innovative solutions, while simultaneously effectively managing resources, budgets, and high-performing teams. Using your strong analytical reasoning and adaptability skills will enable you to navigate through ambiguity and change, ensuring that technology initiatives align with business goals. With your advanced communication and stakeholder management abilities, you will foster productive working relationships and influence decision-making to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes. As a subject matter expert, you will contribute to the development of operational plans and risk management strategies, ensuring the highest quality and professionalism in service delivery.

Job responsibilities

- Develops and executes comprehensive project plans, incorporating technical requirements, resource allocation, and timelines across cloud infrastructure, SRE, and AIOps teams, ensuring on-time delivery of technology solutions

- Identifies and mitigates risks, proactively addressing potential roadblocks and implementing contingency plans across cloud infrastructure, SRE, and AIOps teams to maintain project and program momentum

- Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and business stakeholders, to define program scope, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall business goals

- Utilizes advanced analytical reasoning to assess program performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement data-driven optimizations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness

- Champions the adoption of agile methodologies and technical solutions, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation within the team

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technical program management, leading complex technology projects and programs in a large organization

- Proven experience in technical program management, with a strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, SRE, and AIOps domains

- Advanced expertise in stakeholder management, with the ability to establish productive working relationships and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams and clients

- Advanced experience in utilizing technical fluency, including knowledge of vendor products and managing vendor relations, to enable on-demand access to shared pools of applications and services

- Proven track record of effectively managing resources, budgets, and high-performing teams in a fast-paced, agile environment

- Demonstrated proficiency in applying analytical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to break down business, technical, or operational objectives into manageable tasks and activities

jobs.description:
As a Lead Technical Program Manager in the Consumer and Community Bank- Business Banking Technology, you will help senior leaders run a large-scale technology organization with discipline, transparency, and accountability. You will drive technology projects and programs end-to-end, connect work across teams, and translate execution details into clear updates that support decisions, strengthen controls, and drive measurable outcomes.

You will use your program management expertise, analytical reasoning, and communication skills to bring structure to ambiguous priorities, create clear execution plans, and ensure stakeholders remain aligned on objectives, decisions, risks, and next steps. This role requires strong ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate effectively with technical and business audiences while managing stakeholders effectively.  This is an opportunity to help shape and scale a growing organization while working closely with executive leadership. You will have broad visibility across Business Banking Technology and play a key role in driving execution, supporting strategic initiatives, coordinating across teams, and helping leaders make informed decisions through effective governance, controls, and reporting.

Job responsibilities

- Drive execution of Business Banking initiatives and lead planning and execution for technology programs and leadership priorities across Business Banking Technology.

- Develop program plans, governance cadence, milestones, and action plans that establish clear ownership, accountability, and measurable progress.

- Partner with engineering, product, controls, and business management teams to define program scope, objectives, deliverables, and dependencies aligned to technology and organizational priorities.

- Coordinate across engineering, product, architecture, and business stakeholders, drive delivery reviews and leadership updates, help leaders maintain visibility into progress and decisions

- Use enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate program planning and risk synthesis (e.g., consolidating inputs into integrated plans, RAID, and executive-ready updates), validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity requirements.

- Prepare executive-ready materials, leadership updates, business reviews, governance forums, and communications that summarize status, decisions, risks, and next steps.

- Drive continuous improvement across operating processes, reporting, controls governance, issue management, and execution routines to improve transparency, efficiency, and follow-through.

- Support change execution by coordinating communications, readiness activities, follow-ups, and stakeholder alignment as teams adopt new processes, priorities, and ways of working.

-
Promote reuse-first, AI-assisted practices for program governance and reporting, ensuring human review and alignment to delivery standards.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technical program management, leading complex technology projects and programs in a large organization

- Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, risks, and competing priorities.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business, technical, and operational objectives into actionable plans.

- Demonstrated stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to build productive relationships and drive alignment across senior leaders and distributed teams.

- Experience with Technical Program Manager, Business Management, Chief of Staff–type execution roles, Technology Operations, Large transformation programs, Enterprise technology program management

- Experience with Cross-functional execution, Governance, controls, and issue management, Executive communications and leadership support, Change navigation in a growing organization

- Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support program management workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.

- Ability to review and validate AI-assisted plans, risks, and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and following data handling expectations.

- Experience in preparing executive communications, business reviews, governance materials, dashboards, and status updates for senior business and technology audiences.

- Experience managing program schedules, milestones, risks, issues, decisions, and action items with clear ownership and follow-through.

- Proficiency with PowerPoint, Excel, project tracking, and collaboration tools; strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Experience in financial services, portfolio governance, or large-scale technology operating environments.

- Experience supporting senior leadership forums, including staff meetings, business reviews, governance meetings, executive communications, and cross-functional decision-making discussions.

- Experience across technical program management, business management, technology governance, or related execution roles; candidates with transferable skills across these disciplines are encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) in the Corporate Technology organization, you will drive hands-on execution of complex, cross-functional technology initiatives that improve experiences for multiple groups across the firm, including clients, employees, and stakeholders. You will translate business, technical, and operational goals into executable plans, manage dependencies and delivery risk day-to-day, and navigate ambiguity with strong analytical reasoning. With technical fluency and a bias for action, you will partner closely with product and engineering teams to remove blockers, keep work moving, and deliver outcomes aligned to strategic objectives.

Drive day-to-day execution for complex initiatives by building and managing integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, and delivery commitments across teams.

-
Own program operating rhythms including standups, milestone reviews, RAID management, executive updates, and decision logs to ensure accountability and momentum.

-

-

Strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems into clear plans, decisions, and measurable outcomes.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Program Manager, Applied AI - Markets Operations
jobs.description:
Join a team rebuilding Markets Operations on a governed agentic platform that is already running critical processes in production. You will lead delivery across parallel platform components, connecting engineering, product, controls, and operations to land releases safely and predictably. This is a senior, hands-on role where you own the single release calendar, unblock dependencies, and make progress and impact measurable. You will help define how we measure agentic systems in production and defend those measures with senior sponsors. If you want to drive outcomes, not just produce status reporting, this role is built for you.

As a Lead Technical Program Manager in Applied AI within Markets Operations, you will own the delivery of a governed agentic platform portfolio from planning through release and migration into live operational solutions. You will keep the critical path current, drive cross-team dependencies to closure, and surface trade-offs with clear recommendations. You will define and own a practical metrics framework for delivery, platform health, and business impact, and translate that story to sponsors with evidence that stands up to technical, controls, and audit scrutiny. You will participate in architecture discussions, read decision records, and independently assess whether delivery confidence is supported by evidence.

Job Responsibilities

- Own the single release calendar across all platform component streams, keeping dependencies, milestones, and the critical path explicit, current, and actionable.

- Maintain an end-to-end dependency map across engineering, product, design, controls, and operations partners, and hold commitments recorded in it.

- Surface delivery risks and slippage early, driving issues to resolution with clear recommendations and trade-offs.

- Run an effective delivery cadence (planning, checkpoints, and working forums) that stream leads prepare for and rely on.

- Coordinate release and migration sequencing into live solutions so changes do not break running operational processes in production.

- Define and own a metrics framework covering delivery progress, platform quality and performance, and business impact. The instrumentation for measuring agentic systems is immature across the industry, so expect to build the framework rather than run one you are handed.

- Ensure attribution is evidence-based, assigning issues to the correct pipeline stage, tiering severity consistently, and validating claims before escalation.

- Report outcomes (for example, effort returned to the business and autonomy progression) alongside delivery status, stating clearly where instrumentation does not yet support a claim.

- Own the cadence, content, and narrative for sponsor and senior management reporting, communicating what shipped, what it is worth, what was learned, and what is at risk.

- Maintain the platform decision record, including what was decided, by whom, on what basis, and what depends on it.

- Establish lightweight delivery practices and improve reporting tooling so status is derived from systems teams already work in, not manual collection.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

- Demonstrated experience running parallel technical workstreams to a shared milestone in a large organization, ideally in a regulated, high-stakes environment.

- Technical fluency across software delivery, data, and AI systems, with the ability to follow architecture discussions, read decision records, and independently assess delivery risk.

- Experience designing a metrics framework from first principles for work that has not previously been measured, distinguishing activity measures from outcome measures.

- Proven ability to secure and sustain commitments from teams outside your reporting line through credibility, relationships, and clear accountability.

- Strong executive communication skills, including directly owning sponsor relationships, making complex technical delivery understandable without losing substance, and defending evidence under challenge.

- Demonstrated willingness to challenge assumptions and delivery confidence when evidence does not support them, while keeping delivery moving through shifting priorities.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

- Exposure to AI or agentic systems running in production, including an understanding of what is different about measuring them.

- Experience delivering platform or infrastructure programs where consumers are internal engineering and operations teams.

- Experience partnering with controls, risk, or internal audit on technology delivery evidence and readiness.

- Familiarity with operations processes in markets, banking, or other transaction-heavy environments.

- Experience deriving delivery reporting from engineering systems rather than manual status collection.

About the team:

Applied AI builds and runs the governed agentic platform that Markets Operations is being rebuilt on, including case orchestration, agent serving, context and memory, a policy engine that enforces controls deterministically outside the model’s reach, a governed gateway to firm systems, and an operator interface where people supervise and correct what agents do. Several operational solutions run on the platform today, with more committed.

jobs.description:
Leverage your deep technical expertise and leadership to guide cutting-edge projects, fostering growth and innovation in a dynamic environment.

As a Lead Technical Program Manager in Corporate Technology, you will lead the delivery of complex, high-impact technology programs supporting electronic trading across multi-asset, low-latency market environments (e.g., equities, FX, rates, credit, listed derivatives). You will apply strong technical fluency and pragmatic electronic trading domain knowledge (not “deep specialist” level) to drive measurable business outcomes—improving latency, throughput, resilience, control posture, and time-to-market . You will partner with engineering, product, trading, and operations stakeholders to deliver strategic roadmaps, manage dependencies, and ensure programs align with firm objectives. Your ability to navigate ambiguity, influence decision-making, and coordinate execution across distributed teams will be critical to success. You will help foster a culture of innovation, disciplined delivery, and continuous improvement.

Job responsibilities

- Develop and execute comprehensive program plans integrating technical requirements for electronic trading platforms (low latency, high throughput, high availability).

- Lead cross-functional teams to define program scope, objectives, milestones, and deliverables aligned with trading/business outcomes.

- Drive execution across the full trading lifecycle : market connectivity, order capture, risk checks, smart order routing / execution, market data, post-trade workflows, and observability.

- Identify and mitigate risks by proactively addressing roadblocks and implementing contingency plans across performance, resiliency, and operational readiness .

- Champion agile methodologies and pragmatic technical solutions to drive continuous learning and innovation.

- Assess program performance using data-driven metrics (e.g., delivery predictability, defect leakage, latency/throughput KPIs, stability) and implement optimizations.

- Communicate effectively with stakeholders (engineering leads, product, trading, compliance/risk, operations) to influence decisions and build strong partnerships.

- Manage resources, budgets, and high-performing teams to ensure successful program delivery across multiple workstreams/vendors.

- Contribute to operational planning, incident readiness, and risk management for production trading services (including change management and release governance).

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

Program / Delivery

- Proven expertise delivering complex technology programs within large organizations (multiple teams, dependencies, and senior stakeholder engagement).

- Strong analytical reasoning and structured problem-solving skills; ability to translate objectives into executable plans with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.

- Ability to manage resources, budgets, and teams in an agile delivery environment.

- Excellent stakeholder management skills, building productive relationships and influencing decisions across teams.

Electronic trading domain (broad, multi-asset—not “expert specialist”)

- Working knowledge of electronic trading concepts across multiple asset classes: market structure basics, trading workflows, and the end-to-end order/execution lifecycle.

- Familiarity with common trading controls and constraints : pre-trade risk checks, credit limits, kill switches, throttles, circuit breakers, and operational controls.

- Awareness of core trading system components and patterns: market data distribution, order management/execution services, gateways/adapters, persistence, and monitoring/alerting.

- Understanding of key non-functional requirements in trading: low/ultra-low latency , determinism, jitter control, capacity planning, resiliency, and disaster recovery.

Low-latency technology fluency

- Hands-on experience delivering systems in low latency market environments , including performance engineering considerations (latency measurement, profiling, tuning, and regression prevention).

- Technical fluency including knowledge of vendor products and managing vendor relationships (connectivity, market data, execution platforms, network/hardware/software stacks).

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

- Experience partnering directly with front office stakeholders (trading, product, quant/strats) to prioritize roadmaps and define measurable outcomes.

- Familiarity with industry protocols and integration patterns (e.g., FIX-based order flow concepts; exchange/venue connectivity patterns; market data feed handler concepts).

- Experience with performance and resiliency practices used in trading environments (capacity tests, failover exercises, latency SLOs, post-incident reviews).

- Experience with operational planning and risk management, including release readiness, change governance, and production support models.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills; able to operate effectively in fast-paced environments with high expectations.

- Knowledge of industry-standard program/project management tools and reporting practices.
